about: C. Russell Canestraro is an attorney who represents clients in the Columbus, Ohio area. Russell Canestraro is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2021 - 2023, 2026 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Russell Canestraro chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Ohio Northern University Pettit College of Law and graduated in 1992. Russell Canestraro passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1993.
He represents clients with Workers' Compensation: Claimant issues in Ohio. He also represents clients with General Litigation and Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Russell Canestraro has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
